subject: STABLE 2 shader-coverage-opus + HEAVY RELEASE: 6 compiler fixes (f7 c3e608ed from mali_graphics_compiler.c cbfbb1fe); CA graphics 139/141 pairs, all 142 captured; user gates run
body: Since STABLE 1: (5) zero_undef_read_varyings keeps one zeroed varying when EVERY VS varying is undefined and the FS reads none (Mesa otherwise drops all -> 'Missing or misaligned IDVS varying program'; VideoStabilization). (6) mrt_format_integer + select_mrt_outputs: integer true-MRT targets need matching uint/int outputs (inert until texture-opus lists integer formats in mrt_format_ok; scratch build with 123/124 listed: BGRA8+RGBA32Uint vec4/uvec4 rc0, signedness mismatch refused). Harness: QuartzCore pairs take captured device constant values by name/type from corpus.txt (origin captured_donor) and complete missing required constants by name -> all QuartzCore graphics pairs compile except 2 inplace_copy (raster-order-group texture writes). LEDGER (gpu/build/shader-coverage-20261027/LEDGER.md, ledger.jsonl): functions ok before->after: CA kernel 3/7, vertex 39/39, fragment 73->93/95; UI kernel 364/366, vertex 92->103/113, fragment 144->157/417; all classes 8293->8381/10308; 142/142 captured CA device pipelines. Graphics regression check: 0 regressions, +64 pairs, 1019/1019 previously-compiling pairs byte-identical VS+FS code. GATES (f7): pipeline-pack 142/142, 463/463 entries byte-identical; check_graphics_draw_varyings 81/81 (+baseline), tile_fetch PASS, generic_texture_lowering 58/58, graphics_specialization 66/66; run_host_tests.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH=f7): 68 PASS lines, all sections pass up to the final 'actual iOS bundle strict link' which fails on undefined tegu_air_render_pipeline_variant_count/attach_source/variant_spirv/tegu_air_color_write_table (frontend objects ahead of the stale native iOS libtegu_air_bridge.a; not Mali); texture_format_frontend_test (private copy, own OUT, SC_MALI_DIR=f7): output byte-identical to the same test with the shared Mali lib, everything PASS except RAW_TARGETS ok=0/31 (texture-opus step 2b in flight; same with shared lib); metal_resource_integration_test --candidate: checks=1005; f7 run 7 required failures = shared-lib control run's 6 (ASan two-thread variant cache, CoreAnimation pass 66/42 known, legacy sampler guard, native compute frontend, render variant cache - the latter 4 are link errors '_Block_object_assign/_dispose' from in-flight blocks code) + transient candidate provenance (cdylib being rebuilt during my run). Remaining refusals unchanged from STABLE 1 list (tessellation 830, integer/R32F targets 330, bridge-API inputs 174, argument-buffer pointers 115, compile budget 110, viewport arrays/layers 158, ...). HEAVY RELEASE.
